negative_experience.text: Itching, especially on arms and legs, in an elderly female with gastrointestinal symptoms and new antihistamine use may be a red herring or unrelated, but when combined with fatigue and abdominal discomfort, it should not be dismissed as benign without further investigation for systemic disease like cancer.

Petechiae on palms and soles, combined with fever, tachycardia, dyspnea, and confusion, strongly suggest meningococcemia; do not discount this presentation in elderly patients even without travel or exposure history.
